pages.title: A Hot Bite
pages.text: Use a special hook in a new fishing environment.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Fit a Lavaproof Hook at the Angling Table first. Check the Mackerel’s journal conditions and fish in lava from a safe bank.

pages.title: Fish beyond water
pages.text: Lava and void fishing require suitable tackle and a configured fishing surface. A Blazing Rod has separate rules for Nether fish in other lava.
